All implemented and verified. Here's a summary of what I built in `packages/graphrag-vectors/graphrag_vectors/`:

## New modules

**`filtering.py`** — Pydantic-based filter expression DSL
- `Operator` enum (`eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in_`)
- `FilterExpr` base with `&`/`|`/`~` overloads. `&` and `|` **flatten** (`(a & b) & c` → one `AndExpr` with 3 children); `~~x` cancels to the inner expression.
- `Condition`, `AndExpr`, `OrExpr`, `NotExpr` — each with `evaluate(record)`. `Condition.evaluate` returns `False` for absent fields and guards against type-mismatch comparisons.
- Discriminated-union (`type` literal) so `model_dump()`/`model_validate()` survive JSON round-trips with nested types preserved. Custom `__init__`s allow both positional and keyword construction.
- `F` fluent builder (`F.field >= 21`, `F.field.in_([...])`).

**`timestamp.py`** — `explode_timestamp` (7 keys, empty dict for None/"", correct quarter mapping), `_timestamp_fields_for` (name→type strings), and `TIMESTAMP_FIELDS` (14 entries for `create_date` + `update_date`).

## Modified

**`vector_store.py`** — added `data` field to `VectorStoreDocument`; added abstract `insert`/`count`/`remove`/`update`; extended `similarity_search_by_vector`/`_by_text`/`search_by_id` with `select`/`filters`/`include_vectors`.

**`lancedb.py`** — full rewrite: `fields` constructor param drives a typed pyarrow schema; `create_index` makes a genuinely empty table; `insert` auto-populates `create_date`; `update` preserves `create_date` and sets `update_date`; `remove`/`count`; `search_by_id` raises `IndexError` for missing/removed ids; `select` projection, `include_vectors=False` nulls the vector, and `filters` restrict results while preserving similarity ordering. `date` fields and the built-in `create_date`/`update_date` are exploded into filterable components.

**`azure_ai_search.py`** / **`cosmosdb.py`** — implemented the new abstract methods and updated signatures so they stay instantiable.

**`__init__.py`** — re-exported the new symbols.
